enchantments.tooltip: Armor Mastery +2: Passive: +2 Enhancement bonus to the Max Dex Bonus of your equipped light, medium, or heavy armor. This benefit does not apply to the Max Dex Bonus of a Tower Shield.
Constitution +4: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
